data.rationale: The proposal follows the right procedure and order (IMDb, then Rotten Tomatoes, then compose mail and discard), but it lists director, runtime, rating and Tomatometer as input parameters when they are values read from the sites, it has no friend parameter (only a recipient email), and it leaves out the exact subject and body templates, so an automation would have to guess them.
